name: m13-sweep
about: The back end's sweep M13: a class's own functions (obj.f(), self.f(), f() in its body, W.f() with no self; fields through the class's data, a game field named alone through the object) and hooks written in a class (Walker's before hook on Kuribo::control runs for every Goomba, all of them Walkers; Unused's before and wrap run for none, and each Goomba's control still runs); list methods given function values; lists, bytes and var places across to the mod's own C both ways (a null place runs nothing); % on floats; a local fn that calls itself; module tuple patterns; ?. calls on containers; numbers with a type suffix
